statement: For an ambient-null based plane homeomorphism loop and an arbitrary commuting operator subgroup, the C36 fractional-power contractions extend to a jointly continuous based equivariant contraction, with jointly continuous inverses, on X2, the closure of the union of open loop-group orbits whose actual closed proper operator image has dimension two. This includes arbitrary infinite accumulation. Every fractional power of an endpoint of a continuous path in R2 or the simply connected positive affine group is an exact word of length at most three in that path and its inverse, with the specified based universal-cover lift retained.
depends_on: Grandoni--Ravi--Singh--Zenklusen 2014, author-version Theorem 4.7 and Section 4.3.2, signed-measure splitting; uniform polygonal approximation; C26 Polish open orbit-map theorem; C28 intrinsic line/circle orbit topology and word-path continuity; C29 exact two-point winding comparison; C30 actual operator image; C33 Hilbert--Smith product action; C36 exact Lie closure action and based universal-cover contraction
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; uniform dimension-two open-orbit closure step for C.12
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The three-word equality is proved in the simply connected covering group, and the circle residual equation is proved over R using actual two-point configuration winding.
notes: The signed-measure theorem gives the exact two-alternative planar chord equation; explicit coordinates convert left fractional affine multiplication into horizontal translation. Compactness of the family f_(ut)^epsilon f_(ub) f_(ua)^(-1) controls actual global word isotopies. On nonopen limit orbits the metabelian identity passes from the dense open union, and the path-connected transitive metabelian action is proved to be R, S1, or Aff+(R). Bounded residuals w_i^n f_ti^(-floor(nr_i)) force the unique logarithmic limit on lines. For circles the canonical residual word isotopy is null in each open-orbit Lie group; its two-point winding passes to the boundary and proves the exact real residual equation, removing hidden integer winding. Density then gives all joint continuity, and the inverse loop supplies inverse continuity. Compatibility across the boundary of X2 with its exterior, including dimension-zero/one proper operator cases and the remaining nonopen strata, is explicitly not supplied. C12 remains Open.
